items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the education law and the state finance law, in relation to
enacting the "school anti-violence education act"
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4598

SPONSOR: BAILEY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the education law and the state finance law, in relation
to enacting the "school anti-violence education act"

 
PURPOSE:

To create a stable funding source for school anti-violence education
programs.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Designates the short title; "School Anti-Violence Education
Act"

Section 2. Amends the education law by adding section 115, which contain
the following provisions summarized:

§ 115. Legislative Findings that gun violence and other forms of
violence constitute a crisis that poses a serious threat to the health
and quality of life specifically for youth under 18 years of age.

2. Definitions.

3. Describes the School anti-violence education program.

Section 3. Amends the finance law by adding section 97-bbbbb that
creates the "school anti-violence education fund."

Section 4. Severability Clause.

Section 5 Provides that the act will take effect immediately.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The level of gun violence and other forms of violence have reached a
stage of crisis in the state of New York. There is a serious threat to
the health and quality of life for youth residents ages 18 and under.
Funding specifically allocated to support school-based and/or school
affiliated anti-gun and antiviolence programs will serve to support
youth in areas disproportionately impacted by violence.  Specifically,
urban areas around the state with the highest rates of poverty and unem-
ployment should have funding to provide anti-violence education in their
communities.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

BILL NUMBER: S4598C

SPONSOR: BAILEY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the education law, in relation to funding for school
anti-violence education programs

 
PURPOSE:

The purpose of this bill is to support school anti-violence education
programs.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 would add school anti-violence education programs as an allow-
able school safety activity under the Omnibus school violence prevention
grant program.

Section 2 is the effective date.

New Bill.

Undetermined.

 
LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
